country.evidence_quote: We are a third through fifth grade elementary school in Dos Palos, CA charged with the education of about 575 students. Our district serves breakfast and lunch free of charge to all of our students. One of our biggest accomplishments thus far is housing the Veteran's Memorial built for our local Veterans with the help of donations from our community. It is the only Veteran's Memorial on a school campus in the United States!
